headword: {源義経|みなもとのよしつね}

definitions.explanation: A samurai commander and younger half-brother of Minamoto no Yoritomo, who led the Minamoto to victory over the Taira in the Genpei War. After falling out with Yoritomo he fled north to Hiraizumi, where he was driven to take his own life. He is a favorite tragic hero of legend, noh, and kabuki.

notes:
Usually called {義経|よしつね}. As a boy he was known as {牛若丸|うしわかまる}; the tale of young Ushiwakamaru defeating the warrior monk {弁慶|べんけい} on Kyoto's Gojō Bridge, after which Benkei served him loyally to the end, is known to every Japanese child.

- {判官|ほうがん}びいき: sympathy for the underdog — from Yoshitsune's court title {判官|ほうがん} and the public's pity for him
- {牛若丸|うしわかまる}: Yoshitsune as a boy, hero of children's tales
- {義経|よしつね}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{弁慶|べんけい}: the lord and his devoted retainer, a byword for loyalty
